Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Elijah Isaiah Hall <tiamat@alpha2.csd.uwm.edu> wrote:
>ok, can amaranth still be used after rotscheck since it is a 
>combat type card.  Because, rotscheck states it "ends combat before
>damage is dealt" does this mean i cannot play any more combat cards
>or can i still amaranth, wolf claw, etc.  after a rotscheck has
>been played?

When Rotschreck is played, combat ends, by virtue of the vampire
entering torpor, if for no other reason.  This is like any other
time a vampire enters torpor during combat; cards modifying the
vampire's entry into torpor (Amaranth, Minor Boon) may be used, but
there isn't time to use any other kind of combat card.

BTW, assume that if people start getting into Amaranth vs. Minor Boon
"slap" situations, the order in which cards can be played follows
the Lady Thunder vs. Elysium ruling, namely that acting player gets
first crack, then blocking, then everyone else going clockwise from
the acting player.  I will double check on this.
